note: Status per packet DRY family: concretized (native composition in this concept), reused (shared data/semantics consumed without new composition), not-exercised. Variance notes are the anti-clone evidence: same product behavior, deliberately different composition from the six sibling concepts.

entries.variance_notes: Destinations are a persistent numbered index column (01-12 + utilities 13-14) with icon, count, and changed-count — not cards, tiles, tabs, or an editorial list. The index never leaves the screen at 2- and 3-pane widths.

Attention entries are aligned three-column strips (status word / headline+consequence / Open) in the Home workspace; fixture-pushed notices merge into the same list. At most one critical banner above them.

entries.concept_component: c10-body pane strip + c10-top path bar + c10-foot status strip
entries.variance_notes: The workspace is a left-to-right pane strip under a persistent breadcrumb path bar and above a key-hint status strip; an explicit 3/2/1-pane state machine handles width, with Back naming the parent pane at one-pane widths.

One dropdown component serves the large Home field and the compact path-bar field; grouped kinds, full breadcrumb paths, availability notes, arrow+Enter selection, and a silent #/search history entry so Back restores query and results.
The category pane is a second index: Overview, three sections with counts, managers, reserved destinations — all keyboard-walkable rows with active-state rings, no pills, no accent bars.

Rows are compact aligned table rows (Setting / Value / State) at 34px rhythm — the densest of the seven concepts — with pm-chip-value chips in the value column and honest one-word states in the third.
Shared chip vocabulary placed in a fixed table column so every row's provenance aligns vertically.

The editor is an in-flow panel inserted directly under the row inside the same table — never a modal, never a side sheet. Radio-list selects keep every option visible for keyboard use; Details drawer holds the technical evidence (mono only there).
Reasons are full sentences in bordered note strips inside the editor and under roster items; disabled actions carry their reason inline and as a toast on click.
Managers continue the pane grammar inside the flex pane: a nav column (objects or section jumps) plus a bounded main column; breadcrumb, search, Back, Close and Project identity all persist.
Resources are flat bordered strips with status words and flag pills; deep evidence lives in a per-item Detail drawer rendered as a key/value grid, keeping the roster scannable.
Checks are label/state-word strips that jump to their owning manager; tone words, never gauges.

entries.concept_component: c10-steps + host radio choices (provider setup tab)
entries.variance_notes: Numbered steps with official source and exact host/environment radio selection; the explicit Set up action lives in the manager action strip.
Ops render as phase sentences in the footer strip and, for copy, as an inline meter that is determinate only when the op supplies completed/total. No spinners without words.

entries.concept_component: PMShell.toast over store receipt events + c10-receipt panel
entries.variance_notes: Receipts surface as toasts plus the copy receipt panel with mono ids and a working rollback.

entries.concept_component: grouped connection rosters + object pages with tabs
entries.variance_notes: Providers group by connection kind in the manager root; each provider is an object page whose tabs are the section titles (At a glance / Accounts / Models / Limits / Routing / Installation / Setup / Activity / Advanced).
Installations show In use / Shadowed / Manual only flag pills with their honest notes; actions come only from PMProvider.resolveInstallation and run the shared triggers.
Models are a real aligned table (Model / Context / Modes / Tools / Route) — the concept's compact-table specialty — with routing divergence in the Route column.

entries.concept_component: limits overview items from the shared snapshot
entries.variance_notes: Read-only projection; usage-unavailable renders as an honest muted item with its reason.
Facets are compact selects in one bar; the list is windowed at a fixed 34px row height with spacer divs (Slint ListView-portable); stress rows are visibly tagged.
The four stages are simultaneous panels advancing left-to-right (locked panels dimmed until reached), a typed COPY confirm, and a receipt panel in the fourth position — not a wizard dialog.
Reserved destinations show owner, return contract, and the mono deep link inside a dashed box, plus whatever honest read-only data the shell model carries.
